description: Chinese Academy of Sciences researchers map impervious surface cover across the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau at 30-metre resolution for 2020 and 2022. A feature-fusion classifier combines Landsat 8 annual composites, high-resolution reference imagery and terrain information. The ScienceDB repository distributes GeoTIFF products under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for free non-commercial reuse. These maps can define developed surfaces in runoff, land-change and infrastructure-exposure simulations. Reported precision is high, but recall is approximately 84 and 79 percent for the two years, indicating omitted impervious areas in validation. The maps do not distinguish every asset type or measure its hydraulic behaviour. Small features can be unresolved at the grid scale. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
